description: Umferðarslys is a dataset listed in Icelandic geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by National Land Survey of Iceland. Umferðarslys á þjóðvegum frá árinu 2000. Gögnin byggja á upplýsingum frá Samgöngustofu (áður Umferðarstofu) sem aftur byggir sínar skráningar á lögregluskýrslum og frá árinu 2009 einnig á gögnum frá fyrirtækinu Aðstoð og öryggi. Frá árinu 2007 hafa slysin verið hnituð eftir loftmyndum og eru gæði gagnanna mun meiri frá þeim tíma. Coverage: IS. Its keywords include umferðarslys, GSL, umferðaróhöpp. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-is.
